text_block_list.name: Nail Artist
text_block_list.text:
"—It was an absolute honor to assist with 
your maintenance again, Lady Ramonu. Will 
you be heading to your usual foot care 
salon after this?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thank you very much for your flawless 
work.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems they are temporarily closed 
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text: Shall I look for an alternative salon?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That's out of the question. Entrusting 
myself to an unknown entity...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...Any more of this is a waste of time. 
Take me back to the academy."
